display_long_description:
Void Jump VR is a fast-paced, first-person VR platformer set in a neon-lit, dystopian future where every step could be your last. Step onto floating platforms high above the abyss in this VR sci-fi adventure. Test your courage, master precision jumps, and overcome your fear of heights as you race against time to reach the finish. Collect stars, unlock new worlds, and customize your look with unique skins.
   Void Jump VR will push you to the edge - literally.

[media]

  Use Time to your advantage - freeze the world and leap without fear. Gather Shields to reveal which platforms will hold you - and which are about to fall. Collect stars to unlock new levels, worlds, and skins. Become not only a skilled player but a stylish one too!

  Not sure if the next platform will hold? Use Pickups - throw a cube ahead and test its stability before you leap.

[media]

  Reach the finish, press the button, and see your results: stars earned, completion time, and your personal best. 

[media]

Every level is a new challenge, every finish a victory - can you conquer them all?
